verdict.rationale: Cerebras docs show you can upload already fine-tuned models from an S3 bucket and deploy them to a dedicated endpoint alongside standard models (cerebras-docs-10, cerebras-docs-32), so serving custom fine-tunes is supported. However there is no evidence Cerebras itself performs the fine-tuning/training step on your data — the workflow described is 'fine-tune elsewhere, upload the resulting weights,' not an on-platform fine-tuning job. Missing for 10: documentation of an actual fine-tuning/training API or job on Cerebras, evidence of supported base models for training, and independent confirmation of the upload-to-serve pipeline working end-to-end.
